overview_description.description:
FitHub is the next generation corner store, offering the best high-quality healthy products and everyday essentials and delivering it all to your door in 30 minutes through their neighborhood shops. With a swift mobile app and web store paired with beautifully designed low-cost retail spaces, FitHub is building an exciting brand that's both digitally native and rooted in a highly engaging retail experience.

The company is automating every process of the retail industry, from procurement and vendor management to last-mile delivery, all while delivering an omnichannel seamless experience.

FitHub has a unique private label strategy that has allowed them to build a community around their differentiated products, offering better prices and higher margins. Their offerings include groceries, personal care products, vitamins & supplements, and fresh staples at affordable prices.
